data.title: Allocation-efficient Lua ECS iteration
data.description: Review direct stable-order world:each scan, exact 0-16 callback arities, nested/deferred/error semantics, WASM parity, benchmark evidence, and docs.

data.body: INFO: The final fallthrough return handles count==16, but it silently passes only the first 16 components for any count>16. Correct today because names() caps required at INSPECT_MAX_WITH (16), and the comment documents this. But the invariant is enforced only by that constant elsewhere in the file — if INSPECT_MAX_WITH is ever raised, invoke_each would silently drop trailing components and pass a wrong callback arity rather than erroring. Consider an explicit assert (e.g. count<=16) or deriving the branch cap from INSPECT_MAX_WITH to keep the two in lockstep.

data.reason: Correct and well-tested. Direct stable-order scan is equivalent to the former ID snapshot because structural ops queue via enqueue while depth>0; arity 0-16 unrolling preserves the callback(id, component...) contract and matches() guarantees non-nil args. 6/6 tests pass (incl. arity 0-16, nested stable selection, FIFO flush, error depth restoration), clippy clean, WASM parity check added, docs/benchmark evidence accurate and honestly caveated. One INFO note on the invoke_each/INSPECT_MAX_WITH coupling.

data.body: Added an explicit fail-closed count ~= 16 guard before the final unrolled call site, so a future filter-cap increase cannot silently truncate callback arguments. The 0-16 arity suite remains green.

data.reason: Explicit unsupported-arity guard added and focused ECS suite passes

data.body: Fix verified. The explicit count ~= 16 fail-closed guard (ecs.lua:186) now surfaces an error if INSPECT_MAX_WITH is ever raised above 16, instead of silently truncating callback arguments — exactly the lockstep protection requested. Since names() still caps required at 16, the guard is unreachable defensive code today and behavior is unchanged. cargo test -p console-core --test ecs: 6/6 pass (arity 0-16, nested stable selection, FIFO flush, error depth restoration); clippy clean.

data.reason: Fixes verified — fail-closed arity guard added, tests green, clippy clean
